summary.en: One to three figures a beat apart, each resolving out of symbols (or counting) in its own digit slots, its label rising beside it.
summary.zh: 一到三个数字隔一拍出现，每个在自己的数位里从乱码中定格（或滚动计数），标签随后在旁边升起。

fits: The figures that explain an answer or a problem: one line edited, files rechecked, times faster.
notFor: More than three numbers (a table or a chart); numbers without labels; decoration.

intent.en: Each figure is a fact that arrives on the beat and stays still to be read; the scramble says it was measured, not typed.
intent.zh: 每个数字是一条在拍子上到达、然后停住让人读的事实；乱码定格说明它是量出来的，不是写上去的。

content.en: 1–3 items, each a value (≤ 9 chars) and a label (≤ 26 chars, ≤ 4 words); optional `count` per item; an optional query (≤ 48 chars).
content.zh: 1–3 项，每项一个值（≤ 6 字）和一个标签（≤ 10 字）；每项可选 `count`；可选查询行（≤ 48 个字符）。

fits.zh: 解释答案或问题的那几个数：改了一行、重查了多少文件、快了几倍。

notFor.zh: 三个以上的数字（用表格或图表）；没有标签的数字；装饰。

pairs.note: after the reveal, through its counter
through the slice into the lock-up

en: Every figure must come from the product or be computed from figures on screen (e.g. the ratio to a candidate).
zh: 每个数字要么来自产品，要么由屏幕上的数字算出（比如相对某个候选的倍数）。

overlaps.note: an odometer roll; here symbols in fixed slots or a count, several figures in rows

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
